answer: Give each operator one horizon whose routing capacity decays every epoch; zenith caps what any single key may hold. To keep k live keys on that horizon, every key must be re-bought to zenith with k dawn of accepted output per epoch, and dawn is nontransferable, expiring when issued. The first head costs one dawn; one operator with n heads pays n² dawn each epoch, because spent dawn cannot be pooled, copied, or carried across clones.
